title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for kidney function.

HPI: The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up of chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well and denies any recent urinary symptoms, fatigue, or swelling in the extremities. He is currently managed for hypertension and is adherent to his current regimen. He notes that his blood pressure has been stable at home.

Medication List: Lisinopril 10mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam: The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable with a blood pressure of 128/82 mmHg. Physical exam reveals no peripheral edema and normal skin turgor. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No tenderness in the costovertebral angle.

Assessment: 1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 1. 2. Hypertension.

Plan: Continue current medications for blood pressure and kidney management. Patient instructed to monitor blood pressure at home and maintain a low-sodium diet. Follow up in six months for repeat laboratory work and blood pressure check.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
